jobs.role: hydration robustness of the KVCr edges (JUDGE 3)
jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 KSCF=0.35 KNSCF=0.20 NPOOL=4 NPOOL_NSCF=32 SCF_MAXSEC=10800 RELAX_MAXSEC=14400 python lcm_stage1.py KVCr_2H2O.json
jobs.tests: KV[Cr(CN)6].2H2O model (21 atoms, P1; 2 H2O in the empty 4d void, O-H...N donors): vc-relax LCM at U 3/3 (KSCF 0.35 = 3x3x3), LCM + FM SCF, nscf 6x6x6 -> M = 0, windows/gap vs anhydrous KVCr (kill the 'existing sample' claim if either window moves > 50 %); water levels inferred from gap/window changes (no PDOS in Gate 0).

jobs.role: experimental anchor KV(II)[Cr(III)(CN)6] (T_C 376 K, M_sat 0.125 muB/f.u.)
jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 KSCF=0.25 KNSCF=0.14 NPOOL=8 NPOOL_NSCF=16 SCF_MAXSEC=7200 RELAX_MAXSEC=10800 python pba_chain.py KVCr_chain.json
jobs.tests: Step 1: PBE+U (U_V 3, U_Cr 3) vc-relax in the LCM (Cr(C-end) +, V(N-end) -), LCM + FM SCF, dense nscf (8x8x8, includes X/L/W) -> M_cell = 0, |m_V|,|m_Cr| 2.6-3.0, FM M = 6.00 (no V3+/Cr2+ transfer), windows/edge spins, dE(FM-LCM). Step 2: 2-D U grid (U_V, U_Cr) in {2,4}^2 at the symmetrized relaxed cell: LCM SCF + nscf + FM SCF -> windows unipolar in the V-majority channel >= 0.3 eV at every point; dE for the J ratios.

jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 KSCF=0.25 KNSCF=0.14 NPOOL=8 NPOOL_NSCF=16 SCF_MAXSEC=7200 RELAX_MAXSEC=10800 python pba_chain.py KVMo_chain.json
jobs.tests: As KVCr with U_V 3 / U_Mo 2 (Mo 4d); U grid (U_V, U_Mo) in {2,4} x {0,2} (U_Mo = 0 -> no Hubbard term on Mo). Charge-transfer check: V3+ (2 muB) / low-spin Mo2+ (S = 1) would give FM M = 4 instead of 6 and m 2 instead of 3. Ratio dE(VMo)/dE(VCr) >= 1.15 (T >~ 430 K by ratio scaling of 376 K).

jobs.role: linkage isomer KCr[V(CN)6] of KVCr (full-antisite limit; Kabalan 2008 LDA +1.28-1.32 eV/f.u.)
jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 KSCF=0.25 KNSCF=0.14 NPOOL=8 NPOOL_NSCF=16 SCF_MAXSEC=7200 RELAX_MAXSEC=10800 python pba_chain.py KCrV_chain.json
jobs.tests: Linkage isomer (Cr N-bound, V C-bound): vc-relax LCM at U 3/3, LCM + FM SCF; grid energies at (U_V, U_Cr) in {2,4}^2 (no nscf). Isomer energy E(KCrV) - E(KVCr) >= +0.8 eV/f.u. (protection of the sublattice assignment).

jobs.role: T calibrant Cr(III)[Cr(III)(CN)6] (Schart 2024 Cr[Cr(CN)6]0.996, T_C 240 K)
jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 KSCF=0.25 KNSCF=0.14 NPOOL=8 NPOOL_NSCF=16 SCF_MAXSEC=7200 RELAX_MAXSEC=10800 python pba_chain.py CrCr_chain.json
jobs.tests: T calibrant Cr(III)[Cr(III)(CN)6] (Fm-3m, no alkali): vc-relax LCM at U_Cr 3, LCM + FM + nscf; U_Cr in {2,4}. Calibration dE(VCr)/dE(CrCr) = 1.57 +- 0.25 (= 376/240 K) at base U, on the U diagonal (2,2)/(2) and (4,4)/(4), and in HSE; otherwise no >= 400 K claim.

HSE06 (no U, nq 2x2x2, k [4, 4, 4], 90 Ry / ecutfock 180 Ry) LCM on the exactly symmetrized cell: gap >= 1.0 eV, windows >= 0.3 eV unipolar (V-majority), integer moments, and E(FM) - E(LCM) for the HSE J ratios.

jobs.cmd: python lcm_deep.py KVMo_soc.json soc; python pba_orbm.py KVMo_soc.json
jobs.tests: Noncollinear SOC PBE+U (dojo_fr, U_V 3 / U_Mo 2, 90 Ry) LCM with moments || z and || x: spin residue |M_spin| and MAE (lcm_deep soc); then best-effort cell orbital magnetization (lorbm nscf, pba_orbm.py). Pass: residual |M_spin + M_orb| <= 0.1 muB/f.u.; Mo XMCD M_L = -0.04 muB for comparison.
